codeReview.summary: The analytics tab UI and independent summary hook were added, but the API change returns a fabricated zeroed summary when summary generation fails or delivery tracking is unavailable. That breaks the intended unavailable/error states and can mislead operators with false healthy-looking analytics.

issues.description: The new `summaryOnly=1` path always returns `{ ok: true, summary: ... }` with a synthesized zeroed summary when `getEmailDeliveryAttemptsSummary()` fails or when delivery tracking is unavailable. This masks real backend failures/unavailability and causes the analytics tab to show misleading zero metrics instead of the expected unavailable/error state.

The independent analytics summary request inherits delivery-log search filters (`recipientEmail`, `messageId`, `bookingRef`, `templateType`, `emailType`, and forced-error toggles). The feature brief only called for analytics independence from pagination/time range state, and this coupling means analytics can still appear empty or error due to delivery-log filter state rather than representing tab-level summary metrics.
